java.say: Enclosure keeps a Keeper in a field. That field is the association: an Enclosure knows its Keeper for as long as it exists.
The keeper comes in through the constructor. Enclosure does not create it.
Enclosure calls a method of its Keeper. Because of the field, it can do that in every method.
